verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents cloud-hosted and self-hosted (Mockbin) mock servers, plus dynamic Liquid-templated responses. Mock generation from a spec is documented only as an AI-assisted flow that takes a natural-language prompt alongside an OpenAPI, URL, or JSON input. Missing for 10: evidence of creating mocks from saved request/response examples, a documented non-AI deterministic spec-to-mock path, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the generated mocks work for consumers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a mock server from saved examples or a spec so consumers can build before the API exists

citations.quote: The Insomnia Cloud mock servers allow you to create a mock endpoint in a few steps.
Users can deploy self-hosted mock servers using Insomnia Mockbin.
Auto-generate a mock server from a natural language prompt and one of the following input types: URL, OpenAPI, or JSON.
Creates a mock server from a prompt, OpenAPI definition, or live URL response. Automatically scaffolds routes, responses, and configurations.
Dynamic mocking renders Liquid templates so responses can include: - Data from the request (headers, query parameters, path, or body). - Randomly generated fake data.
